**Generated by `analysis/gen_parameter_register.py` — do not edit by hand.**

Model version: `0.1.0-milestone0` · Parameter set id: `2d6343f41b392d36` ·

Every parameter carries name, definition, units, default, plausible range, source status,
scope (common to all arms or society-specific), sensitivity priority and code location.

**Calibration status: every parameter is `not yet calibrated`.** None was fitted to
empirical data. Values are internally consistent stylised defaults. Where an empirical
source would normally appear and none has been established, the entry says
`not yet calibrated`; where information is absent, `not provided`.

Sensitivity priority drives the screening order in `STATISTICAL_ANALYSIS_PLAN.md` §7:
`high` parameters enter the Latin hypercube and Sobol designs, `medium` and `low` are
screened one-factor-at-a-time first.
